Hi Sarah - great demo earlier, thanks for the time. As promised, attaching the draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that captures the milestones we discussed and proposed owners/target dates. High level: 

- Milestone: PO signed / Contract executed - Target close: 2027-05-07 - Owner: Acme procurement (send PO) / Redwood legal will finalize MSA
- Milestone: Security review + SOC 2 evidence - Target: 2027-04-20 - Owner: Acme security (questionnaire returned) / Redwood to provide artifacts

- Milestone: Pilot start (integration + smoke tests) - Target: 2027-05-15 - Owner: Acme eng + Redwood CSM

Dependencies: receipt of completed security questionnaire, confirmation of deployment region (us-east-1), and PO or signed DocuSign envelope.

Regarding legal redlines: If you can send tracked changes in Word for the MSA (or a redline doc like the one you mentioned), our legal team can take the first pass. To keep timelines predictable, propose the following SLAs for negotiation rounds: initial Redwood review within 3 business days of receiving redlines; counter within 48 business hours thereafter for small changes; 3 business days for substantive, cross-team items. If you prefer to own initial edits, confirm and we'll mark Redwood as reviewer only.

Attached: acme_map_draft_v1.pdf (MAP), example MSA template link in drive.

Next steps: 
1) Sarah: send ACME MSA redlines (Word) + confirmation of security questionnaire owner
2) Redwood: rishi/lauren to confirm legal ownership and turnaround once we have the redlines

Thanks - talk soon.
